experiments.title: Experiment A: Polygonal Ice Scanning
experiments.description: Grid survey of polygonal cryogenic frost wedges. Scan cell sectors using Radar, Neutron, or Thermal sensors to identify pure dielectric slabs.
experiments.scientificYield: Accurate dielectric mapping of 0.8m - 2.5m pure subsurface slab ice.

experiments.title: Experiment B: Stratified Ice Core Extraction
experiments.description: Select drill penetration depth. Deeper cores reach purer ice but consume high rover battery and risk bit-binding in basalt gravel.

experiments.title: Experiment C: Mars Regolith Extraction (MREU) Vapor Chamber
experiments.description: Sublimate ice-regolith slurry and condense water vapor. Verify purity against toxic perchlorate salts (ClO4-).
experiments.finding: Water captured: 94.2% efficiency. CRITICAL DISCOVERY: Magnesium and calcium perchlorate concentration is 0.72 wt%, lethal without multi-stage ion exchange membranes.

experiments.title: Experiment D: Regolith Geomechanics & Bearing Assessment
experiments.instrument: Dynamic Cone Penetrometer & Soil Shear Vane
experiments.description: Measure soil compaction and shear strength to qualify surface stability for future autonomous cargo landing pads.

experiments.title: Experiment A: Ancient Delta Fluvial Reconstruction
experiments.description: Align laser scanner along western delta scarp to reconstruct ancient lakebed bathymetry and sediment deposition rates.
experiments.scienceReward: Verified sustained 200,000-year fluvial lacustrine environment in Jezero paleolake.

experiments.title: Experiment B: Raman & XRF Spectroscopy
experiments.description: Fire UV laser pulses into fine-grain mudstones to identify hydrated smectite clay minerals and carbonate cements.

experiments.title: Experiment C: Potential Biosignature Screening
experiments.description: Screen dense carbonaceous laminae. Detect spatial co-location of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and silicate matrices.
experiments.biosignatureConfidence: High Potential Biosignature (Sample Tube #SY-09 sealed in hermetic titanium sleeve)

experiments.title: Experiment D: Mars Environmental Dynamics Station (MEDA)
experiments.description: Deploy standing environmental sensor mast to log pre-conjunction atmospheric tau (dust opacity) and thermal cycles.

branchingChoice.prompt: DIAGNOSTIC CRITICAL: LREV telemetry reports mechanical drive pinion fissure and incoming continent-scale dust front. What is your command?

optionA.title: Option A: Abort Sample & Immediate Retreat to Gale Crater
optionA.description: Discontinue final deep-strata core extraction. Turn LREV south toward Gale before conjunction locks down communication. (Cautious route / Early return ending)

optionB.title: Option B: Secure Ancient Biosignature Sample (Canon Mission)
optionB.description: Complete the hermetic titanium seal on the high-value Jezero core. The drivetrain fractures completely under load. Stranded at Jezero Field Shelter for the 14-Day Solar Conjunction.
